scope: Organizational projection, not a new registry or executable workflow. Family choices are design judgments based on linked primary sources.

families.name: Catalog and entity modeling

source.title: Backstage catalog descriptors
source.claim: Typed entities, owner and explicit relations support discovery.

families.application: Use a read-only family projection over existing authoritative IDs; distinguish definition from occurrence using our composition contracts.
families.rejected_scope: Do not adopt a second ownership registry or infer execution from catalog lifecycle.
families.benefit: Find related contracts without assigning another writer.

families.name: Schema and interface contracts

source.title: JSON Schema Core 2020-12
source.claim: Schemas identify reusable structures and referenced subschemas.

families.application: Continue JSON Schema for shape; retain separate semantic predicates and interface revisions.
families.rejected_scope: Schema validity alone does not establish units, rights, freshness or truth.

families.name: Typed workflow composition

source.title: CWL Workflow Description
source.claim: Workflow steps connect declared inputs and outputs through a directed graph.

families.application: Keep clean definitions separate from nested instances and explicit port edges.
families.rejected_scope: Do not adopt an engine, general expression language or assume CWL conformance from an analogy.
families.benefit: Reuse check_semantics in two scenarios without copying its definition.

families.name: Entity activity agent provenance

source.title: W3C PROV-O
source.claim: Entities, activities and agents provide distinct provenance roles.

families.application: Represent artifact revision, test activity and responsible owner separately with evidence links.
families.rejected_scope: Attribution is not permission; derivation is not accuracy or current availability.
families.benefit: Trace which bounded run produced a report while preserving archived inputs.

families.name: Design versus runtime lineage

source.title: OpenLineage object model
source.claim: Job and Dataset metadata are distinct from runtime Run events.

families.application: Separate declared dataflow from observed execution receipts; attach immutable evidence only to actual local runs.
families.rejected_scope: Do not emit events or claim live lineage service adoption. Offline receipts are not production runs.
families.benefit: Keep a declared workflow and its actual test receipt independently inspectable.

families.name: Graph constraints and validation reports

source.title: W3C SHACL
source.claim: Graph constraints are separate from the graph being validated and yield validation results.

families.application: Use JSON-first typed-edge and endpoint checks with explicit negative fixtures; preserve a future RDF export boundary.
families.rejected_scope: Reject mandatory RDF/SHACL engine migration now; these local checks do not claim SHACL conformance.
families.benefit: Reject a dangling endpoint or mistaken definition-as-run relation.

selection_rule: Choose by question: catalog for identity/ownership; contracts for shape; composition for port wiring; provenance for derivation; lineage for design/run distinction; graph_qc for relational constraints. These families are complementary, not interchangeable.

examples.question: Where is the historical cutoff interface, and which bounded evidence supports it?
examples.limit: The evidence demonstrates synthetic qualification only; permission and changed-source guards remain deferred.

examples.question: Can two scenarios share the same clean definition while keeping runtime evidence separate?
examples.limit: Port compatibility requires semantic checks too; these example lists are navigation paths, not executable pipelines.

next_actions.action: Extend family annotations only when a new component exposes a concrete discovery or validation need.
Review shared contract implications before any adoption outside the reference map.

field_notes.ref: Local _MAP path plus optional JSON Pointer, checked against this checkout. Pin the containing Git commit when consuming externally.
field_notes.execution_scope: Evidence classification; only offline_reference is represented here.
field_notes.relations: Typed navigation; neither ordering nor dispatch authorization.
field_notes.decision: adopt means retain an already-used technique; adapt means borrow a bounded idea. rejected_scope records what was deliberately excluded.

related_work.limit: Candidate labels are not resolved _MAP objects or accepted contracts. No write authority transferred.
